readme.bannerAlt: Mert Kaya, senior AI engineer and founder of Eschatia Labs
readme.intro: Senior AI engineer and founder of [Eschatia Labs](https://eschatialabs.com), an independent, non-profit open-source AI research lab: a small collective of researchers who publish their preprints, release their models on Hugging Face and keep their code open source. I build small models that run on a laptop, agents you can inspect and detectors that show their evidence.

projects.name: Emberwick
projects.text: A medieval village you play in the browser. Three small decision models decide what the villagers do through storms, fires, markets and wolves.

projects.name: reevesagents
projects.text: Run Claude Code, Codex and 20+ other coding assistants side by side in one terminal, with one of them coordinating the rest. CLI, TUI, Web UI and MCP server. 107 stars, 1.3k npm downloads a month.

projects.name: JevAlt
projects.text: The three 4B decision models behind Emberwick, for English, Turkish and German. Calibrated answers on a laptop with about 3 GB of memory. 3.3k Hugging Face downloads.

projects.name: xdfdet
projects.text: Explainable deepfake detection: eight EfficientNet-B4 models with Grad-CAM evidence, the code behind my thesis and conference paper. 977 Hugging Face downloads.

projects.name: Tholos
projects.text: Small local assistants that share tables, notes and a task board, every action behind a rule. Its model, Tholos-2B: 2.2k Hugging Face downloads.

projects.name: Ultra Mod
projects.text: The all-in-one mod pack for Claude Code. 2.2k npm downloads a month.

readme.projectsCounts: Counts as of 22 October 2026. In total: 9,775 downloads of my AI models and datasets on Hugging Face and 9,982 downloads of my npm packages.

skills.note: With them I fine-tune and evaluate small models (JevAlt, Tholos-2B, JevOss), explain detectors with Grad-CAM (xdfdet) and build agents and MCP servers (reevesagents, Tholos).
